macros.name: footer
macros.doc: To add a footer use the macro \footer{left footer}{center footer}{right footer}.

macros.name: goodfoot
macros.doc: The \goodfoot macro will do the footer for you in the form ”Page x of n”.

macros.name: header
macros.doc: To add a header use the macro \header{left header}{center header}{right header}.

macros.name: joinpdfs
macros.doc: To combine multiple pdf files together into one single pdf file use the macro \joinpdfs{}.

macros.name: newfigure
macros.doc: To include a figure type \newfigure{Caption}{Description}{file name.jpg}{reference}.

macros.name: reffigure
macros.doc: This macro allows figures to be referenced by simply typing \reffigure{reference}.

macros.name: reftable
macros.doc: To reference a table the macro \reftable{reference} can be used.
